_readme: Extra pages for records the automatic sources could not place, found by search.
Only URLs live here. Every coordinate still comes out of the linked page's own
markup, through the same extractor and validators as every other source, so a
seeded record is no more trusted than any other. Nothing is transcribed by hand:
a coordinate typed in from a search result would be indistinguishable from an
Chosen for machine-readable schema.org geo that a server-side fetch can actually
read. Yelp, TripAdvisor, OpenTable and Toast all answer a bot with 403, so their
pages are useless here however good their data is.
`checked` is the date the URL was confirmed to carry a geo block.
